'''OR-B5 Security Droid''' was a [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] model used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] several OR-B5 Security Droid protected the orbital station that was used by [[Nomen Karr]] to spy on [[Empire's Wrath|the apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]] and were destroyed when the Sith discovered the station and assaulted its personnel.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
OR-B5 Security Droids appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Warrior class mission.
